# FCIWannierConstruction

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIWannierConstruction`

```text
FQHETopInsulatorWannierConstruction, version 0.01

Usage: FQHETopInsulatorWannierConstruction [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -x, --nbr-sitex : number of sites along the x direction (default value = 3)
    -y, --nbr-sitey : number of sites along the y direction (default value = 4)
    --torus-kx : total momentum along the x direction for the state on torus (default value = 2)
    --torus-ky : total momentum along the y direction for the state on torus (default value = 6)
    --band : index of the chern band (default value = 0)
    --x-basis : use Wannier states localized along a line parallel to the x direction
    --non-unitary : use non-unitary connection
    --xlq : use XL Qi's recipe (parallel transport in y without considering Wy)
    --flat : assume flat curvature
    --extreme : make the Wannier connection as close to the positive real axis as possible
    --bold : do not choke on inversion breaking, etc.
    --test : dry run, without constructing the many-body wave functions
    --onebody : filename template of the onebody wave functions. _kx_#_ky_#.onebody will be appended
    --sublattice : filename of the sublattice shifts
    --inversion : filename of the inversion matrix
    --input : filename of the input state vector (FQH on torus, with manybody translational symmetry fully reduced)
    --output : filename template of the output vector. _kx_#_ky_#.#.vec will be appended.
    --exact : filename template of the exact diagonalization vector. _kx_#_ky_#.#.vec will be appended.

output options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
